_comment: CI quality-gate thresholds, measured on the REAL public-document eval corpus (data/eval/raw, 19 docs across 5 categories; data/eval/golden_qa.jsonl, 47 answerable + 10 unanswerable questions). Generation eval runs with evidence-gated abstention (--abstention-threshold 0.10). Floors (min) and the refusal-rate ceiling (max) sit with margin around the measured deterministic baseline (TF-IDF, no faiss, no rerank, extractive writer): hit_rate@k 1.0, mrr 1.0 (over the answerable rows), faithfulness 0.583, grounded_rate 0.942, expected_coverage 0.841, answer_relevance 0.912, citation_coverage 0.684, refusal_rate 0.088, refusal_precision 1.0, refusal_recall 0.5. Retrieval is saturated because the corpus is lexically distinct; the discriminating gates are generation faithfulness and abstention precision/recall. Regenerate with: python -m adip.mlops.run_rag_eval --chunks data/processed/chunks.jsonl --index data/processed/vector_index --golden data/eval/golden_qa.jsonl --backend tfidf --no-faiss && python -m adip.mlops.run_generation_eval --index data/processed/vector_index --golden data/eval/golden_qa.jsonl --abstention-threshold 0.10
_multihop_comment: Agent retrieval loop on two-document questions (data/eval/multihop_probes.jsonl, 16 probes) over data/eval/raw + data/eval/long (173 chunks), TF-IDF, extractive writer, rule-based decomposer. Measured: single_pass full_support 0.5625; full (decompose + follow-up searches) full_support 0.75, hop_recall 0.875, gain 0.1875, answer_full_coverage 0.8125 (the extractive writer's answer contains both hops; 0.6875 before chunks kept line breaks, so a return to that writer fails the 0.7 floor); on the 47 single-hop golden questions the full loop keeps hit_rate 1.0 at 1.09 searches per question. Regenerate with: python -m adip.mlops.run_multihop_eval --variants single_pass full
